meta.title: Concesión
meta.goal: Expresa concesión y contraste sofisticado con 'much as', 'whatever', 'however + adj/adv' y 'adj + as/though + sujeto + verbo'.

cards.title: Concesión: qué expresa
cards.lede: Expresa concesión y contraste sofisticado con 'much as', 'whatever', 'however + adj/adv' y 'adj + as/though + sujeto + verbo'.

rows.value: Much as I respect his dedication, I cannot support his proposal.
However compelling the evidence may be, doubts persist.
Difficult though the negotiation was, an agreement was reached.
Whatever the outcome, we remain committed to transparency.

tip.label: Objetivo:
tip.body: reconocer el patrón y usarlo en frases propias.

cards.title: La estructura que debes recordar
cards.lede: Observa la estructura completa antes de producir tus propios ejemplos.

rows.value: Much as + sujeto + verbo de sentimiento/opinión, cláusula principal.
However + adjetivo/adverbio + sujeto + may/can be, cláusula principal.
Adjetivo + as/though + sujeto + verbo, cláusula principal · Qualified as she is, she lacked experience.

cards.title: Ejemplos naturales
cards.lede: Lee cada ejemplo en situaciones reales del día a día.

rows.value: Much as we would like to expand immediately, capital constraints prevent it.
However meticulous our planning might be, unforeseen market shocks occur.
Capable though he is, he struggles under tight deadlines.
Whatever political pressure we face, our audit will remain independent.

cards.title: Cómo cambia el significado
cards.lede: Compara estas opciones para saber cuándo elegir cada una.

columns.label: However + Adjetivo
columns.rule: Funciona como subordinador de concesión al unirse inmediatamente a un adjetivo/adverbio
examples: However hard we tried, we couldn't meet the deadline.

columns.label: However (Conector independiente)
columns.rule: Conecta dos oraciones independientes mediante una pausa (coma tras 'However')
examples: We tried hard. However, we couldn't meet the deadline.

cards.title: Evita este calco
cards.lede: Compara la versión incorrecta con la forma natural en inglés.

lines.text: Much as I admire her work, but I disagree with her conclusion.
Much as I admire her work, I disagree with her conclusion.
lines.note: No incluyas la conjunción 'but' cuando la oración inicia con 'Much as'.

cards.title: Guía rápida de uso
cards.lede: Comprueba las reglas clave para este patrón.

rows.value: 'Exhausted as they were, they pushed on' equivale a 'Although they were exhausted'.
Al usar 'Much as' o 'However adj', NUNCA agregues 'but' en la segunda cláusula.

tip.label: Práctica:
tip.body: escribe una frase personal con el patrón.

quiz.q: ___ I appreciate your perspective, we must adhere to regulatory guidelines.
quiz.explain: 'Much as' introduce una cláusula concesiva formal seguida de un verbo de apreciación/sentimiento.

quiz.q: ___ the challenge may seem, our research team is prepared to address it.
quiz.explain: La estructura 'Adjetivo + as + sujeto + verbo' ('Daunting as the challenge may seem') expresa concesión.

quiz.q: ¿Cuál de las siguientes oraciones utiliza 'however' de manera concesiva avanzada?
options: However complex the system is, we can optimize it.
However, the system is complex and hard to optimize.
The system is complex, however we can optimize it.
However the system complex is, we can optimize it.
quiz.explain: 'However + adjetivo + sujeto + verbo' es la subordinación concesiva correcta.
